car.name: Copperhead SC 2006
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 copper compact coupe. US 2006 factory-supercharged coupe F35 five-speed manual inspiration, standard configuration without optional Performance Package. OEM torque unit typo and generic-coupe geometry limitations are disclosed.

catalogProvenance.inspiration: 2006 US Chevrolet Cobalt SS Supercharged coupe, F35 5MT, LHD, standard configuration without optional Performance Package

sources.kind: Direct GM Heritage scanned OEM table, personally visually inspected physical pages 15-17
fields: LSJ output, F35 gearing, SS Supercharged curb mass and tires, generic coupe dimensions, steering and fuel

estimates: OEM torque unit typo: published 200 lb-ft converts to 271.16358966628 Nm, NOT printed 230 Nm. 205 hp retained rather than treating rounded 152 kW as exactly equivalent.

2925 lb SS Supercharged curb mass converted to kg; fuel/driver convention unspecified and no additional load added. Generic coupe 60/40 distribution, dimensions and 1.4497m front track are not independently SS-trim verified. No silent sedan substitution.

6450 maximum engine speed is mapped to redline, NOT proven fuelcut. 6650 limiter, 800 idle, torque interpolation away from peak, .8bar boost, CG .52m, overhang split, Cd .34, 26USmpg, 140mph/6.4sec display, 32psi setup and normalized suspension/brake/shift/clutch/launch behavior are simulation estimates.

13.2 US gal anchor converts to 49.9672473888 L rather than silently matching printed 49 L. No optional Performance Package or optional LSD assumed; differential0/0 is a simulation assumption, not independently verified hardware.
Original LHD blank binnacle fitted to shared wheel-opening gauges. Shared tire surface smoke/spray, not exhaust.
